wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Two typed rows on the Carr Form A grid, 500.00 + 500.00 = 1,000.00, EXACTLY the cover line 1 figure, which is identical in the THIS-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns (the LAST-REPORT cell is a bare dash: this is the first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide -- recorded cumulative). SUB-$50 TRAP OBSERVED: cover line 2 reports a 350.00 aggregate of contributions of $50.00 or less which is NEVER itemized; the rows were scored against line 1 alone, not against 1,000.00+350.00 = 1,350.00 (the figure the module publishes as stated_total_contributions). The Carr form prints no schedule total on Form A.

expenditures.detail: 53 typed rows over two Form B pages (44 on p3 + 9 on p4) sum to EXACTLY 34,943.19. Three anchors agree: the schedule's own printed grand total at the foot of p4, the cover line 3 THIS cell and the cover line 3 CUMULATIVE cell. LAST-REPORT is a bare dash (first report of the cycle), so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide -- scope recorded cumulative. No per-page subtotal is printed; only the two-page grand total.

gates.page_subtotal: p3+p4 rows 34,943.19 = the schedule's printed grand total 34,943.19 = cover line 3 -- GATES EXACTLY. No per-page subtotal exists (the grand total appears once, on p4). Form A (p2) prints no total at all; its 2 rows were gated against cover line 1 (1,000.00) -- GATES EXACTLY.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 --dpi 200: status ok, 35 bands on the Carr grid, 2 inked = 2 rows emitted. p3: status 'gaps', 44 rules over a 1.85%-pitch grid -> 43 bands, plus the row above the first detected rule (the tool's known top-rule DEBT) = 44 rows; 44 inked, 44 emitted. p4: 9 rules -> 8 bands + the top row = 9 rows; 9 inked, 9 emitted. Total 53 expenditure rows. The printed grand total one band below p4's last row was checked against the grid and deliberately NOT emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: Form A p2: first-row amount box renders '$ 500.00'; last-row (row 2) box renders '$500.00'; the control one pitch below renders EMPTY. Form B: first-row box on p3 renders '$ 193.48' (row 1's own value); last-row box on p4 renders '$ 17,705.18' (row 53) and the control one pitch below renders EMPTY (the grand total lies a further band down, outside the control). Row index confirmed unshifted on every page.
gates.balance_chain: Cumulative column: 1,000.00 (over $50) + 350.00 (<= $50) - 34,943.19 (expenses) = -33,593.19, and the cover's line 4 prints '( 33,593.19 )' -- accounting parentheses, i.e. negative 33,593.19. CLOSES EXACTLY, and only when the <= $50 aggregate is included. No prior filing by this filer in this chunk, so the LAST-report chain could not be run; every LAST cell on this cover is a bare dash.

escalation_note: 600 dpi tight crops for the geometry proof on all four money pages (first row / last row / control), which doubled as a re-read of rows 1, 2, 44 and 53. The schedules are BORN-TYPED and crisp at 200 dpi; no glyph was in doubt and the two-page sum closing to the printed grand total to the cent settles the side independently of any re-read.
notes: Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'Cache County Treasurer', Office District 'Cache County' -- the chunk file's office 'Treasurer' AGREES. Candidate 'Denise N. Lindsay'; chunk says 'Lindsay' -- agrees. Cover date 'July 25, 2014', clerk RCVD stamp 25 JUL 2014 -- agrees with the chunk's 2014-07-25. IN-SCOPE (county office). The cover and Form A are the typed Carr 5-5-PG form; the two Form B pages are a typed spreadsheet attachment in Form B layout with its own '$' column and a printed grand total -- a richer shape than the bare Carr sheet, and the only document in this chunk whose EXPENDITURE schedule prints its own total. Contributor addresses are printed in the clear (both are PO boxes); only city and state were kept, the box numbers and ZIPs were discarded at read time, and the candidate's home street address, ZIP, home phone and business phone on the cover were likewise discarded. The largest single line is a 17,705.18 payment to Renegade Sports for 'Damaged Equipment' dated 7/23/2014, two days before the report -- unusual for a campaign ledger and worth a human eye, but it is printed plainly and the schedule closes with it included. No in-kind column exists on either schedule, so in_kind is false throughout by construction.
